Jimmy Tran
Software Development Engineer V | AI Agentic Systems | .NET | C# | React | Microservices | Cloud

Professional Summary
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with eight years building scalable distributed systems using modern
cloud and microservices architectures.
Experienced in C#, Java, Python, React, and .NET ecosystems designing enterprise grade APIs and event
driven platforms efficiently.
Strong expertise in AI driven workflows, generative AI integrations, and autonomous agent based
orchestration systems across enterprise platforms.
Skilled in AWS cloud services, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and observability practices including
logging metrics and tracing systems.
Proven ability delivering high performance scalable and secure software systems with strong leadership
and technical mentoring experience globally.

automated decision making across enterprise platforms.

• Collaborated with stakeholders to design orchestration layers for distributed AI workflows and
autonomous system improvements continuously.
